description.value: Crystal Pool and Fitness Centre is Victoria's main municipal aquatic and fitness facility, operated by the City of Victoria on Quadra Street in a central neighbourhood. It offers a swimming pool, fitness equipment, and a sauna, making it a practical urban stop for touring cyclists seeking a full shower and workout. A city-run replacement project is underway, so visitors should confirm current operations before planning a stop.
